# Trading Direkt 2026-10-09 | Börsläget med Esbjörn Lundevall, Aktiestrateg på SEB & Tobbe med TA

**Feed**: trading-direkt  
**Published**: 2026-10-09  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

SEB equity strategist Esbjörn Lundevall says Nordic earnings forecasts are still being revised up and earnings growth is broadening ahead of Q3 reports. He names rising long-term rates and energy prices as the main risks. He sees Swedish small caps at a record discount to large caps and set up for a comeback, thinks Nordic AI/data-center suppliers are underestimated, prefers Wärtsilä, Alfa Laval, Mycronic, Novonesis, Kongsberg and MilDef, and is negative on Norwegian oil companies and Norsk Hydro. In the technical-analysis segment, Tobbe Rosén sees a short-term risk of further OMXS30 weakness but is constructive on seasonality, and gives stock-level technical views. He is positive on Lifco, Bico, Gapwaves, Investor and Note, and negative on Hemnet, Intrum and Nobia.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 WRT1V — Wärtsilä | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

SEB strategist names Wärtsilä among the most buy-worthy Nordic stocks; also large AI data-center exposure.

#### Reasoning

Guest (SEB strategist): well-run company, attractively valued, riding strong trends such as marine, energy and data-center power demand. AI data-center exposure is seen as underestimated and sentiment is currently gloomy, leaving room for positive surprise.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI/data-center investment wave stalls
- if Q3 orders disappoint
- if valuation re-rates to premium

> *"Då ska jag ta Wärtsilä i Finland."*

---

### 🟢 ALFA — Alfa Laval | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

SEB strategist's buy-worthy pick: well-run, attractively valued, with underestimated data-center exposure.

#### Reasoning

Guest (SEB): Alfa Laval sells to shipyards, shipowners, refineries and energy efficiency, with some data-center exposure he considers underestimated. Strong Q2 order intake across engineering supports good Q3 reports.

#### Sell Triggers

- if marine/energy order intake weakens
- if long rates rise enough to hit equity valuations

> *"lite datacenter har du ju i Alfa Laval som jag tycker känns som en underskattad exponering"*

---

### 🟢 MYCR — Mycronic | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest calls Mycronic a very impressive, well-run tech company with large AI exposure and lists it as buy-worthy now.

#### Reasoning

Guest (SEB): Mycronic stands out with large AI data-center exposure driving orders, sales and earnings. It is attractively valued and among his top picks. AI-supplier sentiment is depressed, so he sees room for positive surprise.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI capex cycle slows sharply
- if order growth disappoints

> *"skjuter jag även in Mycronic som jag tycker är ett jätteimponerande bolag inom mera tech"*

---

### 🟢 NSIS-B — Novonesis | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Danish pick: well-run, attractively valued, riding protein/food and bioenergy trends.

#### Reasoning

Guest (SEB) lists Novonesis among the most buy-worthy Nordic stocks. He describes it as very well run, attractively valued and exposed to structural protein/food and bioenergy trends.

#### Sell Triggers

- if biosolutions growth slows
- if valuation expands to premium

> *"och så Novonesis i Danmark som allihopa då så att säga både är synnerligen välskötta bolag och som är attraktivt värderade"*

---

### 🟢 KOG — Kongsberg Gruppen | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Preferred way to get defence exposure, instead of the fully valued Saab.

#### Reasoning

Guest (SEB): the defence sector's growth outlook is 'brilliant'. With Saab fairly fully valued, Kongsberg in Norway is suggested as the better vehicle for defence exposure.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a peace deal reduces defence budgets
- if valuation becomes stretched

> *"så tycker jag man kan ta ut det via Kongsberggruppen i Norge"*

---

### 🟢 MILDEF — MilDef | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Smaller Swedish defence alternative to Saab suggested by the SEB strategist.

#### Reasoning

Guest (SEB): defence growth prospects are strong. Among smaller Swedish companies, MilDef is offered as an alternative way to get exposure while Saab looks fully valued.

#### Sell Triggers

- if defence spending momentum fades
- if order intake disappoints

> *"Eller Mildef bland de lite mindre företagen i Sverige."*

### 🟡 SAAB-B — Saab | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

SEB considers Saab already fairly fully valued and holds a neutral view despite the strong sector outlook.

#### Reasoning

Guest (SEB): defence is a strong growth sector, but Saab's valuation already reflects this, so the view is neutral. He prefers Kongsberg or MilDef for exposure.

#### Sell Triggers

- if valuation expands further without earnings upgrades

> *"Sen tycker vi att Saab redan är ganska så fullvärderad. Så där har vi en mer neutral syn på aktierna."*

---

### 🔴 NHY — Norsk Hydro | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

SEB has a sell on Norsk Hydro as an indirect Middle East/energy case; expects normalization next year.

#### Reasoning

Guest (SEB): explosive earnings this year are tied to the energy price spike. SEB expects normalized energy prices next year and a poor revision trend, but admits the crisis has lasted longer than expected.

#### Sell Triggers

- if energy crisis persists longer, keeping prices elevated
- if earnings revisions turn positive

> *"och även sälj på Norsk Hydro som på ett indirekt sätt också är ett Mellanöstern-relaterat case"*

### 🟢 LIFCO-B — Lifco | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

TA screen: RSI2 below 5 at MA200, bounce edge, possible move toward ~325; already up ~1.9% on the day.

#### Reasoning

Host TA (Tobbe Rosén): rubber band stretched with RSI2 under 5 at the 200-day MA. MACD contraction suggests a positive trampoline. Upside toward ~325, where reversal levels and a falling resistance line meet. Part of the move had already happened at the open.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price breaks below MA200
- if rejected at falling resistance near 325

> *"Men Lifco ser intressant ut kortsiktigt översåld då."*

### 🟠 BONEX — Bone Support | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

TA: bullish engulfing at a tight cluster of moving averages; breakout above ~239 on volume could trigger a rally.

#### Reasoning

Host TA: bullish engulfing where standard line, MA20, MA50 and MA200 converge, with low volatility and a coiled spring. Already up 2.2%, so there is a risk of a counter-reaction. Wait for a strong close above 239-239.10 on rising volume.

#### Sell Triggers

- if fails to close above 239
- if falls back below the MA cluster

> *"ett utbrott upp över den här nivån med stark stängning över de här svansarna som vi ser här med 239 239 och 10 kan ju absolut om den sker med tilltagande volym leda till en full uppgång"*

### 🟢 BICO — Bico | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

TA medium-term screen: 'strength breeds strength', consolidation with positive volume balance; very interesting on ~3 months.

#### Reasoning

Host TA: Bico has risen over three months and is consolidating with a positive undertone and positive volume balance, which favours a continued move up on a 3-4 month horizon.

#### Sell Triggers

- if consolidation breaks down
- if volume balance turns negative

> *"Så Bico, jätteintressant på medellång sikt."*

### 🟢 GAPW-B — Gapwaves | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

TA: rounded bottom, up ~40% in a month and short-term stretched; pullback toward MA200 or a cup-and-handle is interesting.

#### Reasoning

Host TA likes the rounded-bottom formation. After a ~40% rise in a month it may need a pullback, possibly forming a cup-and-handle. Gaps and turtle soups are interesting entries.

#### Sell Triggers

- if pullback breaks below MA200
- if continuation pattern fails

> *"Gapen och Turtles upp är ju helt klart intressant att agera på tycker jag i Gapwaves. Jätteintressant."*

---

### ⛔ HEM — Hemnet | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 75%

TA: at all-time low since listing, lower highs, can't break Fib50; host clearly negative.

#### Reasoning

Host TA: very oversold but with no sign of buyers. It keeps making lower highs and fails at Fib50 of the latest swing, so more downside is likely. He needs the last short-term top taken out and the Fib50 of the decline from 83 SEK passed without a new lower low.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price takes out last short-term top and Fib50 of decline from 83 SEK
- if new higher low forms

> *"Så jag är tydligt negativ till Hemnet."*

---

### ⛔ INTRUM — Intrum | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

TA: steep downtrend testing spring 2024 low, no positive candlestick; sellers in control ahead of report on the 23rd.

#### Reasoning

Host TA: very oversold, with only a slight positive stochastic divergence. Not a single positive candlestick formation (strong close above the prior day's high) since the decline, so sellers lead. Needs confirmation and a break above the short-term top.

#### Sell Triggers

- if strong close above prior day's high followed by confirmation
- if price breaks above latest short-term top

> *"Och det ser vi inte ännu och då är det mer som talar för nedgång."*

---

### 🟢 INVE-B — Investor | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 75%

TA: clean rising trend, repeated bounces on MA100; MACD crossing zero could trigger the next leg; host very positive.

#### Reasoning

Host TA: Investor is in a nice rising channel, pulled back to the 100-day MA and bounced several times. Stochastic MACD is softening up the zero zone, and a pass above zero has historically preceded clear moves up.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price breaks below MA100
- if MACD fails at zero line and turns down

> *"Så jag är mycket positiv till Investor."*

---

### 🟠 NANEXA — Nanexa | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

TA: extreme rally; host says positive but entry tricky near top. Risk grows below Fib50 of gap or below 6.70 (Fib62).

#### Reasoning

Host TA: after an extreme rise, profit-taking risk is high when supports break. The standard line was reclaimed (positive). He calls himself positive but cautions about entering close to the top and suggests trailing stops. A stronger volume balance would be a sign of strength.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price falls below Fib50 of gap and doesn't reclaim
- if price breaks below 6.70 (Fib62)

> *"Så jag är mycket positiv, men det är som sagt, ska man kliva på här så är det lite knepigt."*

---

### ⛔ NOBI — Nobia | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

TA: rejected at MA100, below all short and long moving averages; only a slight positive divergence.

#### Reasoning

Host TA is negative: the rally attempt stalled at the 100-day MA and price has broken the 100/50/20-day MAs and the standard line. Momentum has flattened, so consolidation is possible, but more points down than up.

#### Sell Triggers

- if new higher low forms and price breaks above medium MAs and last short-term top

> *"Det var det som var nästa och det är Nobia som jag är negativ till."*

---

### 🟢 NOTE — Note | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

TA: rounded bottom plus flag, momentum resuming; target ~225 SEK, invalidated below 164.

#### Reasoning

Host TA: after the decline, a rounded bottom formed, followed by a small flag, and price is moving up again. The measured move gives a target around 225 SEK. The pattern fails if price breaks the flag low at 164.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price breaks below 164 flag low

> *"Jag är positiv till note och tycker det ser ut som att den har goda förutsättningar för att gå vidare upp från den här nivån då."*

---

### 🟠 LUMI — Lundin Mining | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

TA volatility screen: lowest Bollinger band width since July, triangle contraction, slightly rising MA200; expecting expansion.

#### Reasoning

Host TA: extremely low volatility and a tight range with converging moving averages often precede a powerful expansion. The rising MA200 is a mild positive, but the breakout direction is unconfirmed, so this is a watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- if breakout occurs to the downside

> *"Så den kan vi absolut hålla koll på tycker jag."*

---

### 🟠 SMOP — Smart Optics | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

SEB strategist's 'favorite' with large AI data-center exposure; segment seen as underestimated with gloomy sentiment.

#### Reasoning

Guest (SEB) calls Smart Optics a favorite in Nordic AI data-center exposure. Sentiment toward the group is currently depressed, which he thinks leaves better potential for positive surprise. No explicit buy recommendation was given.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI investment wave proves unsustainable

> *"Smart Optics en annan favorit som har mycket exponering mot det här"*
